title: Our guide, Guillaume,...
text: Our guide, Guillaume, was friendly and dynamic. He provided us with relevant and interesting information throughout the day on various topics. He adjusted well to the fact that there were people speaking French and others speaking English. He easily alternated between the two languages. He regularly ensured that everything was suitable for us. Personally, I would have spent more time in Girona rather than visiting a third village in the afternoon, but otherwise, it was a beautiful day. I recommend this excursion!
author: AnnieClaude_P

title: Small group tour done perfectly
text: Our tour was fantastic. The small group made it so much fun.  Ivan was excellent: very knowledgeable and very attentive to our preferences. It was a perfect balance of history, views, nature and relaxation.

title: Girona and Medieval Villages
text: We had a great day trip with William to visit Girona, Besalu and Castellfollit de la Roca. William was very nice and gave lots of great information. We had a small group of 7 which was perfect. The villages are so beautiful, so much history! Besalu is a great stop for lunch. Very happy we took this tour, thanks William!
author: Trail51663665712

title: Girona - Wonderful Tour
text: Guilo was a wonderful guide. Girona was a beautiful city to see and the history we learned was appreciated. The drive to the two other medieval villages was very scenic. All in all a great day - highly recommend taking this tour.
author: Jennifer_D

title: A Special Tour Unlike Others
text: We were a small but mighty group, and it felt like we were being invited into the world of the Catalonians.  Our guide Fabrizio made me feel like I was a good friend, and he simply wanted to show me the best of what this area of Spain had to offer.  Such history, stunning views, a proud culture, was wonderful to be whisked away to the lovely countryside for the day.
author: mkondz

title: A Brilliant Day
text: Our trip was cancelled at last minute and we went on Girona and Costa Brava trip with Rebecca. It was a wonderful day. Rebecca was really personable and full of knowledge. The mix of Girona with a Medieval town followed by lunch at the beach was perfect.
author: Teresa_J

title: Medieval Villages Tour
text: Our trip with Giulio to the medieval villages was amazing!!!  We visited three magical medieval villages in the countryside of Catalonia.  It was like going back in time.  The towns were beautiful and each was unique and fascinating. There was also gorgeous scenery.  Giulio is an incredible guide - extremely knowledgeable, engaging and fun - and we learned so much.  More than just a tour, it felt like going on an amazing adventure off the beaten path with a local friend who knew the best places to visit.  We are so grateful for this experience!
author: S5937BQrobinp
